title: Lightly Crisp Venezuelan Boudin Blanc Tagine
description: A salty and crisp one-pot Venezuelan dish featuring boudin-blanc, this tagine is a unique fusion of flavors, satvik-friendly and cooked to perfection in a ceramic tagine, with a base of fry-grind-rice-khao-khua.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the boudin-blanc and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the fry-grind-rice-khao-khua, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the water to the tagine and bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Cook for 25 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the top is lightly crisp.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
